extends.description: Parent profile name, or a list of parent profile names. Parents are resolved in order and their packages merged (deduped) before this profile's exclude and packages are applied.

packages.description: Package references (tap/package) to install when this profile is applied. Always installed, even if also listed in exclude.

exclude.description: Package references (tap/package) to drop from the packages inherited through extends. Does not affect this profile's own packages.
